verses.sloka: भर्तारं निहतं दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणं च महावलम् ।विललाप भृशं सीता करुणं शोककर्शिता ।। ६.४८.१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: bhartāraṁ nihataṁ dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇaṁ ca mahāvalam ।vilalāpa bhṛśaṁ sītā karuṇaṁ śokakarśitā ।। 6.48.1 ।।।।

translations.english: On seeing her husband killed and also mighty Lakshmana, Sita became emotional in intense sorrow and cried piteously.

verses.sloka: ऊचुर्लक्षणिनो ये मां पुत्रिण्यविधवेति च ।ते ऽद्य सर्वे हते रामे ज्ञानिनो ऽनृतवादिनः ।। ६.४८.२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ūcurlakṣaṇino ye māṁ putriṇyavidhaveti ca ।te 'dya sarve hate rāme jñānino 'nṛtavādinaḥ ।। 6.48.2 ।।।।

translations.english: "Whoever was capable of predicting the future have said that I will be the mother of sons and not become a widow. Now if Rama is dead, they become liars."

verses.sloka: यज्वनो महिषीं ये मामूचुः पत्नीं च सत्रिणः ।ते ऽद्य सर्वे हते रामे ज्ञानिनो ऽनृतवादिनः ।। ६.४८.३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yajvano mahiṣīṁ ye māmūcuḥ patnīṁ ca satriṇaḥ ।te 'dya sarve hate rāme jñānino 'nṛtavādinaḥ ।। 6.48.3 ।।।।

translations.english: "Whoever conducted sacrificial ceremonies and are knowledgeable of sastras have told me that I would be consort. They are all liars now as Rama is killed."
translations.hindi: जाम्बवान, स्कन्ध, रम्भ, शतवलि, एथु, ये सब अपनी अपनी सेनाओं के व्यूह. बना कर हाथों में बड़े बड़े पेड़ों को ले कर, ऊपर नीचे और चारों दिंशाओं की ओर देखते हुए खड़े हो गये । उस समय उनकी ऐसी दशा हो रही छै थी कि, यदि वे तिनकाभी हिलता देखते, तो वे वहाँ राक्षस का होना निश्चित कर लेते थे

verses.sloka: ऊचुः संश्रवणे ये मां द्विजाः कार्तान्तिकाः शुभाम् ।ते ऽद्य सर्वे हते रामे ज्ञानिनो ऽनृतवादिनः ।। ६.४८.४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ūcuḥ saṁśravaṇe ye māṁ dvijāḥ kārtāntikāḥ śubhām ।te 'dya sarve hate rāme jñānino 'nṛtavādinaḥ ।। 6.48.4 ।।।।

translations.english: "The astrologers, brahmins who have promised me to be auspicious and all the wise who have spoken are liars if Rama is killed."

verses.sloka: वीरपार्थिवपत्नी त्वं ये धन्येति च मां विदुः ।ते ऽद्य सर्वे हते रामे ज्ञानिनो ऽनृतवादिनः ।। ६.४८.५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vīrapārthivapatnī tvaṁ ye dhanyeti ca māṁ viduḥ ।te 'dya sarve hate rāme jñānino 'nṛtavādinaḥ ।। 6.48.5 ।।।।

translations.english: "Whoever has told me that I will be the wife of a man of great prowess, worshipped by husband, and all wise men are liars if Rama is killed."
translations.hindi: रावण ने प्रसन्न हो अपने पुत्र इन्द्रजीत को बिदा किआ : और सीता जी की रक्षा करने वाढो राक्षप्तियों को अपने पास मुलबाया

verses.sloka: इमानि खलु पद्मानि पादयोर्यैः किल स्त्रियः ।आधिराज्ये ऽभिषिच्यन्ते नरेन्द्रैः पतिभिः सह ।। ६.४८.६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: imāni khalu padmāni pādayoryaiḥ kila striyaḥ ।ādhirājye 'bhiṣicyante narendraiḥ patibhiḥ saha ।। 6.48.6 ।।।।

translations.english: "Those virtuous lotus marks that a woman has on their feet to become crowned queen of a kingdom are seen in my feet."
translations.hindi: उसक्री आज्ञा पाते ही त्रिजटा. सहित सब'राक्षसी उसके समीप आई । तब राक्षसराज् अत्यन्त हर्षित हो, उन राक्षसियों से कहने लगा

verses.sloka: वैधव्यं यान्ति यैर्नार्यो लक्षणैर्भाग्यदुर्लभाः ।नात्मनस्तानि पश्यामि पश्यन्ती हतलक्षणा ।। ६.४८.७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vaidhavyaṁ yānti yairnāryo lakṣaṇairbhāgyadurlabhāḥ ।nātmanastāni paśyāmi paśyantī hatalakṣaṇā ।। 6.48.7 ।।।।

translations.english: "Those inauspicious signs found in unlucky and widowed women are difficult to find in me. I do not see any such signs in me."
translations.hindi: तुम जा कर सीता से कहो कि, इन्द्रजीत ने श्रीरामचन्द्र और लक्ष्मण को मार डाला । फिर उसको पुष्पकबिमान में बिठा कर समरभूमि में उन दोनों मरे हुए को दिखलाओ

verses.sloka: सत्यनामानि पद्मानि स्त्रीणामुक्तानि लक्षणैः ।तान्यद्य निहते रामे वितथानि भवन्ति मे ।। ६.४८.८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: satyanāmāni padmāni strīṇāmuktāni lakṣaṇaiḥ ।tānyadya nihate rāme vitathāni bhavanti me ।। 6.48.8 ।।।।

translations.english: "Characteristic marks of lotuses, unfailing in their effect (truthful) predicted are all false if Rama is killed."
translations.hindi: जिसके बल के गब से गर्वित हो बह मुझको कुछ नहीं सममती थी, वही उसका पति अपने भाई सहित युद्ध में मारा गया

verses.sloka: केशाः सूक्ष्माः समा नीला भ्रुवौ चासङ्गते मम ।वृत्ते चारोमशे जङ्घे दन्ताश्चाविरला मम ।। ६.४८.९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: keśāḥ sūkṣmāḥ samā nīlā bhruvau cāsaṅgate mama ।vṛtte cāromaśe jaṅghe dantāścāviralā mama ।। 6.48.9 ।।।।

translations.english: "My hair is fine and dark, my eyebrows are uniform and not joined, my shanks are round devoid of hair, and my teeth are closely set."

verses.sloka: शङ्खे नेत्रे करौ पादौ गुल्फावूरू च मे चितौ ।अनुवृत्तनखाः स्निग्धाः समाश्चाङ्गुलयो मम ।। ६.४८.१० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhe netre karau pādau gulphāvūrū ca me citau ।anuvṛttanakhāḥ snigdhāḥ samāścāṅgulayo mama ।। 6.48.10 ।।।।

translations.english: "My temporal bones, eyes, hands, feet, ankles, thighs are even, and my fingers are fleshy and round with nails proportioned and bright."
translations.hindi: अब वह दानां को मरा हुआ देख कर, निराश हो ज्ञायमी और अपनी रक्षा का अन्य उपाय न देख,

verses.sloka: स्तनौ चाविरलौ पीनौ ममेमौ मग्नचूचुकौ ।मग्ना चोत्सङ्गिनी नाभिः पार्श्वोरस्काश्च मे चिताः ।। ६.४८.११ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: stanau cāviralau pīnau mamemau magnacūcukau ।magnā cotsaṅginī nābhiḥ pārśvoraskāśca me citāḥ ।। 6.48.11 ।।।।

translations.english: "My breasts are well formed and developed, the nipples are depressed and joined, the navel is deep, and the surrounding part is fleshy."
translations.hindi: और निरपेक्ष हो वह विशालनयनी स्वयं मेरे पास चली आवेगी । दुष्ट रावण के इन वचनों को सुन,

verses.sloka: मम वर्णो मणिनिभो मृदून्यङ्गरुहाणि च ।प्रतिष्ठितां द्वादशभिर्मामूचुः शुभलक्षणाम् ।। ६.४८.१२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: mama varṇo maṇinibho mṛdūnyaṅgaruhāṇi ca ।pratiṣṭhitāṁ dvādaśabhirmāmūcuḥ śubhalakṣaṇām ।। 6.48.12 ।।।।

translations.english: "My complexion is like the shine of a gem. My hair on the skin is soft. When I touch the ground with my ten fingers and toes, it is said to leave auspicious marks."
translations.hindi: ¢ ww w (9 ५०) ओर “बहुत अच्छा” कह, वे राक्षसियाँ बहाँ गई, जहाँ पुष्पक विमान रखा था। वे राद्दासियाँरावण की आज्ञा से उस पुष्पक 222" विमान को ले

verses.sloka: समग्रयवमच्छिद्रं पाणिपादं च वर्णवत् ।मन्दस्मितेत्येव च मां कन्यालक्षणिनो द्विजाः ।। ६.४८.१३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: samagrayavamacchidraṁ pāṇipādaṁ ca varṇavat ।mandasmitetyeva ca māṁ kanyālakṣaṇino dvijāḥ ।। 6.48.13 ।।।।

translations.english: "My palms and feet placed together have no space which are auspicious marks and brahmins have said that my gentle smile is also a mark of auspiciousness."
translations.hindi: ओर अशोकवाटिका में बैठी हुई जानकी जी के पास पहुंची । राक्षसियों ने पति के शोक से दुर्बल

verses.sloka: आधिराज्ये ऽभिषेको मे ब्राह्मणैः पतिना सह ।कृतान्तकुशलैरुक्तं तत्सर्वं वितथीकृतम् ।। ६.४८.१४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ādhirājye 'bhiṣeko me brāhmaṇaiḥ patinā saha ।kṛtāntakuśalairuktaṁ tatsarvaṁ vitathīkṛtam ।। 6.48.14 ।।।।

translations.english: "The prediction of astrologers that I will be consecrated with my husband and all that is falsified."

verses.sloka: शोधयित्वा जनस्थानं प्रवृत्तिमुपलभ्य च ।तीर्त्वा सागरमक्षोभ्यं भ्रातरौ गोष्पदे हतौ ।। ६.४८.१५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śodhayitvā janasthānaṁ pravṛttimupalabhya ca ।tīrtvā sāgaramakṣobhyaṁ bhrātarau goṣpade hatau ।। 6.48.15 ।।।।

translations.english: "Having gained Janasthana and crossing the ocean which is impossible knowing about my whereabouts and getting me is impossible since the brothers have been killed by the maya of Indrajith whose footprints are like a cow's hoof."
translations.hindi: वे राक्षसी श्रीराम लक्ष्मण को न के लिए उसे (सीताको) जे गई । उधर रावण ने पताकाओं और ध्वजाओं से लक्का को सजवा दिया

verses.sloka: ननु वारुणमाग्नेयमैन्द्रं वायव्यमेव च ।अस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरश्चैव राघवौ प्रत्यपद्यताम् ।। ६.४८.१६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nanu vāruṇamāgneyamaindraṁ vāyavyameva ca ।astraṁ brahmaśiraścaiva rāghavau pratyapadyatām ।। 6.48.16 ।।।।

translations.english: "Raghavas knew to use Varuna's weapons, fire god's weapons, Indra's also, even wind god's and Brahma's weapons. Why have they not used?"
translations.hindi: ओर सारे नगर में उस राक्षसराज ने प्रश्‍न हो यह ढिंढोरा पिटवा दिआ कि, समर में इन्द्रजीत ने श्रीरामचन्द्र आर. लम को मार डाला

verses.sloka: अदृश्यमानेन रणे मायया वासवोपमौ ।मम नाथावनाथाया निहतौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।। ६.४८.१७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: adṛśyamānena raṇe māyayā vāsavopamau ।mama nāthāvanāthāyā nihatau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।। 6.48.17 ।।।।

translations.english: "Indrajith remaining invisible in war by conjuring could kill my husband who is equal to Indra in valour. Rama and Lakshmana! I am orphaned now."
translations.hindi: उधर त्रिजटा सहित पुष्पकबिमान में बैठी हई सीता ने रण- क्षेत्र में जा कर देखा कि, ( प्रायः ) समस्त अथवा बहुत सी; वानरी सेना मरी हुई पड़ी है

verses.sloka: न हि दृष्टिपथं प्राप्य राघवस्य रणे रिपुः ।जीवन् प्रतिनिवर्तेत यद्यपि स्यान्मनोजवः ।। ६.४८.१८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: na hi dṛṣṭipathaṁ prāpya rāghavasya raṇe ripuḥ ।jīvan pratinivarteta yadyapi syānmanojavaḥ ।। 6.48.18 ।।।।

translations.english: "Even if the enemy is endowed with speed of thought, if he comes in the range of Rama's sight, he will not go alive."
translations.hindi: सीता ने. मॉसभक्षी राक्षसा को अत्यन्त हर्षित देखा और (कुछ) दुखी बानरों को, श्रीरामचन्द्र के अगल बगल खडे हुए देखा

verses.sloka: न कालस्यातिभारो ऽस्ति कृतान्तश्च सुदुर्जयः ।यत्र रामः सह भ्रात्रा शेते युधि निपातितः ।। ६.४८.१९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: na kālasyātibhāro 'sti kṛtāntaśca sudurjayaḥ ।yatra rāmaḥ saha bhrātrā śete yudhi nipātitaḥ ।। 6.48.19 ।।।।

translations.english: "Rama along with Lakshmana has fallen in the battlefield. Time spirit is too heavy and capable of doing anything, so difficult to conquer."

verses.sloka: न शोचामि तथा रामं लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम् ।नात्मानं जननीं वापि यथा श्वश्रूं तपस्विनीम् ।। ६.४८.२० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: na śocāmi tathā rāmaṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ ca mahābalam ।nātmānaṁ jananīṁ vāpi yathā śvaśrūṁ tapasvinīm ।। 6.48.20 ।।।।

translations.english: "When I think of Rama or even great warrior Lakshmana, or my mother or myself I am not so sad as when I think of my motherinlaw who is an observer of austerity."
translations.hindi: उन दोनों बीरोंके कवच टूट गए थे तथा उनके धनुष अलग पड़े हुए थे। शरीरा के समस्त अङ्गप्रत्यङ्ग बाणों से विद्धथे । वे ऐसे जान पड़ते थे, मानों बाणों के खम्भे पथिवी पर पडे हों

verses.sloka: सा ऽनुचिन्तयते नित्यं समाप्तव्रतमागतम् ।कदा द्रक्ष्यामि सीतां च लक्ष्मणं च सराघवम् ।। ६.४८.२१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sā 'nucintayate nityaṁ samāptavratamāgatam ।kadā drakṣyāmi sītāṁ ca lakṣmaṇaṁ ca sarāghavam ।। 6.48.21 ।।।।

translations.english: "She will also be worried and wait for Rama who has completed his vow (for fourteen years) and Lakshmana and Sita to come."
translations.hindi: पुरुषश्रेष्ठ, शूरवीर, कमलनयन दोनों भाइयों को सीता जी ने वहाँ अग्नि के पुत्रों की तरह सोते हुए पाया

verses.sloka: परिदेवयमानां तां राक्षसी त्रिजटा ऽब्रवीत् ।। ६.४८.२२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: paridevayamānāṁ tāṁ rākṣasī trijaṭā 'bravīt ।। 6.48.22 ।।।।

translations.english: Looking at Sita, worried, Trijata said 'Devi, do not despair. Your husband is alive'.
translations.hindi: ऐसे बीर दोनों भाइयों को वाणंशय्या पर शयन करते देख, अत्यन्त 'दुःखी हो, सीता अति करुणापूर्वक विलाप करने लगीं

verses.sloka: मा विषादं कृथा देवि भर्ता ऽयं तव जीवति ।। ६.४८.२३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: mā viṣādaṁ kṛthā devi bhartā 'yaṁ tava jīvati ।। 6.48.23 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Devi! Rama and Lakshmana are alive. I see great reasons for this."
translations.hindi: अपने भ्त और लक्ष्मण को धूल में लोटते देख, सर्वाङ्ग- सुन्दरी और काले नेत्रों वाली सीता रोने लगी

verses.sloka: कारणानि च वक्ष्यामि महान्ति सदृशानि च ।यथेमौ जीवतो देवि भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।। ६.४८.२४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kāraṇāni ca vakṣyāmi mahānti sadṛśāni ca ।yathemau jīvato devi bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।। 6.48.24 ।।।।

translations.english: "If a husband ceases life in war, their face will not have an angry look or happy appearance."

verses.sloka: नहि कोपपरीतानि हर्षपर्युत्सुकानि च ।भवन्ति युधि योधानां मुखानि निहते पतौ ।। ६.४८.२५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nahi kopaparītāni harṣaparyutsukāni ca ।bhavanti yudhi yodhānāṁ mukhāni nihate patau ।। 6.48.25 ।।।।

translations.english: "Vaidehi! Indeed, this aerial car called Pushpaka which is an auspicious one would not have brought you if they are ceased of life."

verses.sloka: इदं विमानं वैदेहि पुष्पकं नाम नामतः ।दिव्यं त्वां धारयेन्नैवं यद्येतौ गतजीवितौ ।। ६.४८.२६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: idaṁ vimānaṁ vaidehi puṣpakaṁ nāma nāmataḥ ।divyaṁ tvāṁ dhārayennaivaṁ yadyetau gatajīvitau ।। 6.48.26 ।।।।

translations.english: "The army chief killed, the interest of the troop lost, Pushpaka will move about without making an effort like the ship which lost the helmsman."

verses.sloka: हतवीरप्रधानां हि हतौत्साहा निरुद्यमा ।सेना भ्रमति सङ्ख्येषु हतकर्णेव नौर्जले ।। ६.४८.२७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hatavīrapradhānāṁ hi hatautsāhā nirudyamā ।senā bhramati saṅkhyeṣu hatakarṇeva naurjale ।। 6.48.27 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Lady, given to austerities! These monkeys are guarding Kakuthsa as proclaimed by me lovingly. Do not be confused. They are safe."

verses.sloka: इयं पुनरसम्भ्रान्ता निरुद्विग्ना तरस्विनी ।सेना रक्षति काकुत्स्थौ मया प्रीत्या निवेदितौ ।। ६.४८.२८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: iyaṁ punarasambhrāntā nirudvignā tarasvinī ।senā rakṣati kākutsthau mayā prītyā niveditau ।। 6.48.28 ।।।।

translations.english: "This army is not doubting, not perturbed also, that they are killed. They are guarding the Kakutsthas lovingly. I am telling you."

verses.sloka: सा त्वं भव सुविस्रब्धा अनुमानैः सुखोदयैः ।अहतौ पश्य काकुत्स्थौ स्नेहादेतद् ब्रवीमि ते ।। ६.४८.२९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sā tvaṁ bhava suvisrabdhā anumānaiḥ sukhodayaiḥ ।ahatau paśya kākutsthau snehādetad bravīmi te ।। 6.48.29 ।।।।

translations.english: "I have not uttered untruth earlier nor shall I do now. Indeed, you have found entry into my mind being a woman of good disposition."

verses.sloka: अनृतं नोक्तपूर्वं मे न च वक्ष्ये कदाचन ।चारित्रसुखशीलत्वात् प्रविष्टा ऽसि मनो मम ।। ६.४८.३० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: anṛtaṁ noktapūrvaṁ me na ca vakṣye kadācana ।cāritrasukhaśīlatvāt praviṣṭā 'si mano mama ।। 6.48.30 ।।।।

translations.english: "These two are not capable of being won in war even by gods or demons. On observation of the indications by me I am making you realize."

verses.sloka: नेमौ शक्यौ रणे जेतुं सेन्द्रैरपि सुरासुरैः ।तादृशं दर्शनं दृष्ट्वा मया चावेदितं तव ।इदं च सुमहच्चिह्नं शनैः पश्यस्व मैथिलि ।। ६.४८.३१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nemau śakyau raṇe jetuṁ sendrairapi surāsuraiḥ ।tādṛśaṁ darśanaṁ dṛṣṭvā mayā cāveditaṁ tava ।idaṁ ca sumahaccihnaṁ śanaiḥ paśyasva maithili ।। 6.48.31 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Mythili! Even though both of them have fallen and unconscious under arrows their body splendour has not diminished. You may see."

verses.sloka: निस्सञ्ज्ञावप्युभावेतौ नैव लक्ष्मीर्वियुज्यते ।प्रायेण गतसत्त्वानां पुरुषाणां गतायुषाम् ।दृश्यमानेषु वक्त्रेषु परं भवति वैकृतम् ।। ६.४८.३२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nissañjñāvapyubhāvetau naiva lakṣmīrviyujyate ।prāyeṇa gatasattvānāṁ puruṣāṇāṁ gatāyuṣām ।dṛśyamāneṣu vaktreṣu paraṁ bhavati vaikṛtam ।। 6.48.32 ।।।।

translations.english: "Normally when we see men who have ceased life and stopped breathing their features are unappealing."

verses.sloka: त्यज शोकं च मोहं च दुःखं च जनकात्मजे ।रामलक्ष्मणयोरर्थे नाद्य शक्यमजीवितुम् ।। ६.४८.३३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tyaja śokaṁ ca mohaṁ ca duḥkhaṁ ca janakātmaje ।rāmalakṣmaṇayorarthe nādya śakyamajīvitum ।। 6.48.33 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Janaka's daughter! You give up grief and delusion about Rama and Lakshmana. They are alive, no doubt."

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्याः सीता सुरसुतोपमा ।कृताञ्जलिरुवाचेदमेवमस्त्विति मैथिली ।। ६.४८.३४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tu vacanaṁ tasyāḥ sītā surasutopamā ।kṛtāñjaliruvācedamevamastviti maithilī ।। 6.48.34 ।।।।

translations.english: Sita who was like deity, on hearing the words of consolation, spoken by Trijata, greeted Trijata with palms together.

verses.sloka: विमानं पुष्पकं तत्तु सन्निवर्त्य मनोजवम् ।दीना त्रिजटया सीता लङ्कामेव प्रवेशिता ।। ६.४८.३५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vimānaṁ puṣpakaṁ tattu sannivartya manojavam ।dīnā trijaṭayā sītā laṅkāmeva praveśitā ।। 6.48.35 ।।।।

translations.english: Then Trijata took Sita in the Pushpaka chariot endowed with the speed of mind and entered Lanka.

verses.sloka: ततस्त्रिजटया सार्धं पुष्पकादवरुह्य सा ।अशोकवनिकामेव राक्षसीभिः प्रवेशिता ।। ६.४८.३६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastrijaṭayā sārdhaṁ puṣpakādavaruhya sā ।aśokavanikāmeva rākṣasībhiḥ praveśitā ।। 6.48.36 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter Sita along with Trijata went to Pushpaka. Making Sita to get down, rakshasi also entered Ashoka grove.

verses.sloka: प्रविश्य सीता बहुवृक्षषण्डां तां राक्षसेन्द्रस्य विहारभूमिम् ।सम्प्रेक्ष्य सञ्चिन्त्य च राजपुत्रौ परं विषादं समुपाजगाम ।। ६.४८.३७ ।।
verses.transliteration: praviśya sītā bahuvṛkṣaṣaṇḍāṁ tāṁ rākṣasendrasya vihārabhūmim ।samprekṣya sañcintya ca rājaputrau paraṁ viṣādaṁ samupājagāma ।। 6.48.37 ।।

translations.english: Having entered the Rakshasa's pleasure garden which had many trees, Sita gave way to intense sorrow having keenly observed the king's sons. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेअष्टचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the forty eighth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
